values.name: Any%
values.rules:
**Any% rules :**

Beat the game, no restrictions.
___

**Timing :**

Timing starts from first input (-7.7 seconds from a 0 file).

Timing stops on the last hit on Bowser.

Runs under **27:00** for **Any% (Normal)** are retimed without loads and with milliseconds by the moderators. If your time is over 27:00 in this category, submit your final time on time w/o loads and leave time w/ loads blank and do not use milliseconds.
___

**Other notes :**

All runs require video proof. No vid, no did. Please make the start of the run line up with the start of the video.

All runs must start from a fresh new file or 0 file. Starting from a quick save (save with a balloon) is not allowed.

Must be done in single player, multiplayer isn't allowed.
___

values.name: All Castles
values.rules:
**All Castles rules :**

Complete every Koopaling castle, and beat the game. The use of secret levels is allowed as long every Koopaling castle is completed.
___

**Timing :**

Timing starts from first input (-7.7 seconds from a 0 file).

Timing stops on the last hit on Bowser.

Put your final time in time w/o loads and without milliseconds as this category isn't affected by the removal of loads for top times unless if it's decided in the future by mods.
___

**Other notes :**

All runs require video proof. No vid, no did. Please make the start of the run line up with the start of the video.

All runs must start from a fresh new file or 0 file. Starting from a quick save (save with a balloon) is not allowed.

Must be done in single player, multiplayer isn't allowed.
___

**100% rules :**
Beat the game with 100% completion. 100% means get 5 stars on your save file. This include:

-Defeating Bowser
-Completing every single level and their secret exits
-Getting all star coins from every level
-Catching Nabbit in all 7 worlds
-Completing Superstar Road

Going into Toad Houses are not required
Fighting overworld enemies are not required
Using Nabbit is technically allowed but you need all levels marked as **blue**.

___

**Timing :**

Timing starts from first input (-7.7 seconds from a 0 file).

Timing ends when you see the message ""You've completely cleared Story Mode! Amazing!" (second text box after 9-9)

Put your final time in time w/o loads and without milliseconds as this category isn't affected by the removal of loads for top times unless if it's decided in the future by mods.

___

**Other notes :**

All runs require video proof. No vid, no did. Please make the start of the run line up with the start of the video.

All runs must start from a fresh new file or 0 file. Starting from a quick save (save with a balloon) is not allowed.

Must be done in single player, multiplayer isn't allowed.
___

*Mod note: Retimed to 43:33*

"An A press actually has three parts to it.
When A is pressed, when A is held, and when A is released.
And together, this forms one complete A press.
Now, usually, it's the pressing that's useful.
Because that's the only part that makes Mario jump.
However, sometimes it's sufficient to just use the holding part, which allows Mario to do little kicks, to swim in water, to fall slowly while twirling, and to fall slowly with the wing cap. 
And as for the release, well, there's currently no cases where that's useful or important, so don't worry about that part. Except for 8-2, where you could save 2 minutes, by not jumping directly into the mole and just PB by 4 minutes."

Timing ends when you see the message ""You've completely cleared Story Mode! Amazing!" (second text box after 9-9) on the second game.
___

**Other notes :**

All runs require video proof. No vid, no did. Please make the start of the run line up with the start of the video.

All runs must start from a fresh new file or 0 file. Starting from a quick save (save with a baloon) is not allowed.
